text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: image-pull errors from external registry while provisioning new nodes. failing manifests / auth errors for nv/cuda images, seen across us-west-2 and eu-central. paging oncall. link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/98765

sam.price: I'm oncall, grabbing initial logs. seeing repeated `401 Unauthorized` and intermittent `504 Gateway Timeout` from registry oauth endpoint. looks like token exchange failing, not just bandwidth.

maria.k: taking ownership. confirmed scaling backlog: autoscaler queued 18 pending pods due to ImagePullBackOff. new node bootstrap stuck at container runtime step.

lee.t: quick check: headers show `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0` and `x-ratelimit-reset` a few secs later, then immediate 401. vendor token-service clearly being throttled.

sam.price: paste of kubelet error snippet:
```
Mar 15 02:01:12 ip-10-0-4-233 kubelet[1234]: E0315 02:01:12.123456    1234 remote_image.go:345] PullImage "docker.io/nv/cuda:12.1" failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unauthorized: authentication required
Mar 15 02:01:12 ip-10-0-4-233 kubelet[1234]: failed to pull image "docker.io/nv/cuda:12.1": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve reference "docker.io/nv/cuda:12.1": failed to fetch token: unexpected status: 504 Gateway Timeout
```

devops-bot: note: provisioning-runner has retried 5 times for node pool `g5-provisioners` (job id 789). escalating to engineering if not resolved in 20m.

maria.k: immediate mitigation options: 1) fallback to our internal artifact cache `registry-internal.redwood` (we have pre-pulled cuda variants there), 2) temporarily disable autoscaler to avoid spinning up more nodes that will fail, 3) pre-bake AMI with necessary images for hot nodes. i'll start 1 and 2 now.

runtime-eng: on it — flipping routing for image pulls from docker.io -> registry-internal.redwood for matching nv/cuda images. issuing cluster-level imagePullSecrets override where possible.

sam.price: command I'm running on the cluster to force local cache pulls: `kubectl --context prod exec -n kube-system -it registry-proxy-0 -- crictl pull registry-internal.redwood/nv/cuda:12.1`

cs-jade: heads-up — a few customers are reporting model-serving pods failing to start. preparing a short status note for affected customers. recommend P1 incident page and a short ETA.

lee.t: started toggling autoscaler: `kubectl -n kube-system patch hpa autoscaler-nodepool --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":0}}'` — setting to 0 to stop further launches. will restore after we confirm fallback.

sam.price: vendor status page shows an incident for their OAuth token service. they report "degraded performance" starting ~01:45 UTC. https://status.dockerhub.com/incidents/abcde

maria.k: declaring P1 given customer impact and cross-region scope. assigning communications: cs-jade on customer comms, runtime-eng on rollback/mirror, sam.price on oncall coordination.

runtime-eng: deploying proxy rule to rewrite image pulls for `docker.io/nv` -> `registry-internal.redwood/nv` for all clusters. patch applied to imagePullSecrets, will monitor.

sam.price: verification: pre-bake succeeded for 5 nodes in us-west-2 using AMI `ami-prebaked-nv-20260315`. new pods on those nodes are passing init and starting.

devops-bot: action: nodepool `g5-provisioners` scaled down 80% and 5 pre-baked nodes launched.

maria.k: update timeline for incident page: impact started 01:44 UTC, mitigation (internal registry fallback) started 02:03 UTC, visible recovery for most services 02:12 UTC. still seeing intermittent 429s for a small subset of image pulls hitting the public registry.

cs-jade: posted to status.redwood.com: "We've detected failures pulling some GPU images from a third-party container registry. We are routing pulls to our internal mirror and working to restore normal operations. Some jobs may have delayed starts. No data loss. Updates will follow."

lee.t: note for postmortem - consider automatic switch to internal mirror when external auth returns 401/429 > threshold. also need pre-baked GPU AMIs in eu-central.

sam.price: handoff: i'm going offline for 15m to coordinate with vendor via their support channel. maria.k taking lead for incident until i return.

maria.k: acknowledged, i'm triaging remaining failing pods and tracking customer tickets. tagging vendor contact: @vendor-support — need token service ETA.

vendor-support: (external) working on root cause, token service overloaded by a rolling credential rotation. mitigation in progress, estimated restoration 30 minutes.

maria.k: thanks. will keep autoscaler off for the time being and keep mirror in place. if vendor confirms full restoration, we'll slowly re-enable autoscaling and revert image rewrite rules.

sam.price: returned, vendor confirmed partial restore at 02:25 UTC, tokens issuing again but rate limits still showing soft failures. recommend two-step revert: 1) enable autoscaler with low burst, 2) remove pull rewrite for non-gpu images only.

runtime-eng: staged revert completed for control plane. monitoring metrics: image pull success rate back to 98% in us-west-2, eu-central at 95%.

cs-jade: customer comms updated: "Recovery in progress; most services recovered as of 02:26 UTC. We will follow up with a detailed incident postmortem."

maria.k: declaring incident on-call rotation complete, handing off to sam.price for postmortem action items. closing live mitigation thread, will open postmortem thread with TTL 7d. :white_check_mark:
